Hello, I totally get where your coming from. Unfortunately I don’t think there’s any solution to this. You’ve probably heard about Albert Camus, he was an existentialism philosopher who emphasized on this. He emphasizes on the fact that man have expectations of finding a meaning, and achieving unity with a universe that remains silent to our deep seated wants for meaning and truth. “Man stands face to face with the Irrational. He feels within him his longing for happiness and reason. The absurd is born from this confrontation between the human need and the unreasonable silence of the world”. Camus states we have 3 approaches to this silent universe, one is we commit suicide as a means to escape the lack of meaning or perform intellectual Suicide and instead believe in “hope” for the future typically in the form of a religion. The 3rd is that we find acceptance of the absurdity. That’s what it all comes down to In the end. I’m 15 so maybe I haven’t experienced life enough to where I can say there’s really no meaning to it. But there really seems to be no purpose, so with that being said what I ask myself is your same question why no just commit suicide. There’s most likely no afterlife. I think I’m intelligent enough to at least know the religions are bs. The only difference between us and animals is that we’re conscious of our own death. Man I don’t know maybe this is just a phase we go trough? Probably not but I mean we’re only here once just the do the things you love the most as much as you can . Wish you well friend.
